tools.name: item_list
tools.title: List test items
tools.description: List the test items of the open binary in address order. The tool exists only in the cli test registry.

binary_id.description: The ID of the target binary. Leave it out when exactly one binary is open.

format.description: The detail level. The detailed form adds provenance, coercion details and sizes.

fields.description: JSON pointers into data. The result keeps only these fields.

max_chars.description: The largest result in characters. The count includes every copy of the result.

limit.description: The largest number of items on one page.

cursor.description: The page.next_cursor of the previous page.

count_only.description: Return only the count of the items.

shape.description: The form of the items. The table form gives cols and rows.

in.description: Keep only the members of this named set, for example set:parsers.

session.description: The session label for provenance, filters and the undo scope.
